caveats: Needs a success ping request for an up check to arrive while that check is past alert_after, i.e. a ping request concurrent with a sendalerts pass.

Depends on Django Model.save() without update_fields issuing a full-row UPDATE keyed only by pk, overwriting status and alert_after with stale in-memory values (Django ORM behaviour outside the tree).
Depends on the database running read-committed autocommit with no row locking, so ping's SELECT-then-save spans sendalerts' UPDATE (no select_for_update or transaction.atomic on either path).
Assumes web workers and the sendalerts daemon run concurrently with separate DB connections, as in R3/docker/uwsgi.ini:7,16.
subclaims.reason: Ping requests load the Check with Check.objects.get in R3/hc/api/views.py:37 and call Check.ping at R3/hc/api/views.py:58. For a success ping on an up check, ping keeps status up with no Flip (R3/hc/api/models.py:324-332), recomputes alert_after (R3/hc/api/models.py:334) and issues a full-row self.save() (R3/hc/api/models.py:337). Concurrently the sendalerts daemon selects the same check past alert_after (R3/hc/api/management/commands/sendalerts.py:103-105) and flips it via a conditional q.update(status=down) plus Flip insert (R3/hc/api/management/commands/sendalerts.py:128-137). If ping's SELECT runs before sendalerts' UPDATE and ping's save() runs after, the save overwrites status down with stale up and alert_after None with a recomputed future value, losing the down transition without an up Flip. The interleaving spans separate autocommit statements with no select_for_update or transaction.atomic on either side, which read-committed isolation permits. The two sides run in separate processes with separate DB connections, web workers versus the attached sendalerts daemon (R3/docker/uwsgi.ini:7,16), so the GIL is irrelevant.
